交互式摄像机控制设计
summary: 一个完全零资源的交互式3D鸟类宏观观察体验，封装在单一HTML文件中。世界内含超过15867根实例化的3D曲线多瓣羽毛，每根羽毛由多达111069个细小羽支组成，层叠于16层天鹅绒般的绒毛底层，呈现无缝圆润轮廓。环境包括金色阳光照射下有晶莹的雪覆盖的庭院、折射的玻璃温室、樱花盛开、体积光和飘雪效果。支持无碰撞穿越开启的天窗飞行，有缓慢多角度宏观镜头轨道、锐利的景深散景效果。音效由Web Audio API实时合成，包括鸟鸣、翅膀拍打及温室混响。完全由Three.js、自定义GLSL和Web Audio API通过纯数学程序生成，无任何外部模型、贴图或音频文件。
summary_en: A fully zero-asset interactive 3D macro bird-watching experience packed into a single HTML file. It features over 15,867 instanced 3D curved multi-barb feather plumes (111,069 individual barbs) layered over 16 velvety down undercoat shells forming a seamless round silhouette. The environment includes a golden-hour snowy yard, refractive glass greenhouse, blooming sakura, volumetric sunbeams, and exterior falling snow. The bird autonomously flies collision-free through an open skylight with slow multi-angle macro camera orbits and sharp macro depth of field bokeh. Real-time procedural audio synthesis generates bird trills, wing beats, and greenhouse reverb. Everything is procedurally generated by Three.js, custom GLSL shaders, and Web Audio API from pure mathematics with no external 3D models, textures or audio files.
title: Shima Enaga 3D

搭建多通道WebGL2渲染流水线，支持折射、深度纹理、泛光和宏景深后处理
用Web Audio API实时合成鸟鸣、翅膀声、环境声和混响
集成摄像机控制与隐藏控制面板提供多功能开关
打包为单文件HTML，无任何外部依赖
